The *Suvaṇṇabibbohaniyattheraapadāna* is a verse biographical poem preserved in the Therāpadāna section of the Pali Khuddakanikāya [SuttaCentral]. Like other texts in the collection, it recounts the past meritorious deeds and karmic fruits associated with an elder of the Buddhist monastic order, here the thera Suvaṇṇabibbohaniya [SuttaCentral]. Although SuttaCentral records no English title, it notes the existence of translations in five modern languages [SuttaCentral].
No direct cross-language parallels in Sanskrit, Chinese, or Tibetan are identified for this text [DharmaNexus]. Portions of verses spanning segments §3.1–6.1 are widely shared with other Therāpadāna accounts, such as the *Sudhāpiṇḍiyattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 93), *Ākāsukkhipiyattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 263), *Tamālapupphiyattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 193), *Supāricariyattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 163), and *Mandāravapupphiyattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 363) [DharmaNexus]. DharmaNexus also aligns several segments (particularly §4.1–5.1) with ten passages in the commentary to the *Theragāthā* (*Theragāthā-aṭṭhakathā*) [DharmaNexus].
